title: 第233章  尸晶！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

剑光一线。

穿过两具古尸之间的缝隙。

灰袍老人仓促后退，却还是慢了半步。

黑幡边缘被斩开一道口子。

幡中怨魂顿时失控，反向撕咬幡身。

灰袍老人怒吼：“宋青山！”

宋青山淡淡道：“叫这么大声，显得你很急。”

他再度出剑。

灰袍老人终于露出惊惧之色。

他原以为宋青山敲钟后必然虚弱，自己至少能拖住他一刻钟。

可没想到，宋青山不仅没有被拖死，反而越打越准。

不是力量更强。

是打法更狠、更省、更冷静。

灰袍老人知道不能再拖。

再拖下去，不是他拖住宋青山，而是宋青山斩了他。

他猛地咬破舌尖，将一口黑血喷在尸魂幡上。

黑幡瞬间燃起墨绿色鬼火。

那两具残余古尸也随之暴涨气息，胸口尸晶裂出血纹。

沈冰心脸色微变。

“他要爆尸晶！”

宋青山眼神一冷。

六具古尸本就是灰袍老人留下的关卡。

现在关卡拦不住，他便要引爆尸晶，用尸煞冲击拖住两人。

这种爆炸范围极大。

若在林道炸开，不仅宋青山和沈冰心会受波及，连后方山庄防线都可能被尸煞污染。

不能让它爆。

宋青山一步踏出。

至阳真气与玄阴柔劲同时运转。

阴劲缠尸。

阳劲封晶。

他双手结印，硬生生将两具古尸胸口即将爆裂的尸晶压住。

灰袍老人狞笑：“你压得住一息，压得住十息吗？”

“压一息就够了。”

宋青山低声道。

灰袍老人心头一跳。

下一瞬，沈冰心已经出现在侧面。

她手中不是银针。

而是一柄短刃。

短刃刃口涂着淡金色药液。

她速度不如宋青山，也不如陆沉。

但她出手时机太准。

灰袍老人全部注意力都在宋青山身上，根本没想到沈冰心会主动近身。

短刃划过。

灰袍老人握幡的右臂齐肘而断。

黑幡脱手。

宋青山立刻一剑挑起黑幡，至阳真火瞬间点燃。

尸魂幡在半空燃烧。

幡中怨魂尖叫着冲出，却被沈冰心的安魂香包裹，怨气一点点散去。

灰袍老人惨叫后退，断臂处黑血狂喷。

他脸上第一次露出真正的恐惧。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The sword shines brightly.

Go through the gap between the two ancient corpses.

The old man in gray robe retreated hastily, but was still half a step too slow.

There was a cut on the edge of the black flag.

The resentful spirit in the flag suddenly lost control and bit the flag's body in reverse.

The old man in gray robe roared: "Song Qingshan!"

Song Qingshan said calmly: "Screaming so loudly seems like you are in a hurry."

He drew his sword again.

The old man in gray robe finally showed a look of fear.

He originally thought that Song Qingshan would be weak after ringing the bell, and he could hold him off for at least a quarter of an hour.

Unexpectedly, not only was Song Qingshan not dragged to death, but he became more and more accurate with his beatings.

Not more powerful.

It’s about playing harder, more economically, and more calmly.

The old man in gray robe knew that he could not delay any longer.

If he drags on any longer, it won't be him holding Song Qingshan back, but Song Qingshan killing him.

He bit the tip of his tongue violently and sprayed a mouthful of black blood on the corpse flag.

The black flag instantly ignited into a dark green will-o'-the-wisp.

The aura of the two remaining ancient corpses also surged, and the corpse crystals on their chests were cracked and bloody.

Shen Bingxin's expression changed slightly.

"He wants to explode the corpse crystal!"

Song Qingshan's eyes turned cold.

The six ancient corpses were originally the checkpoints left by the old man in gray robe.

Now that the level can't stop him, he will detonate the corpse crystal and use the zombie impact to drag the two of them down.

This explosion has a huge range.

If it explodes on the forest road, not only Song Qingshan and Shen Bingxin will be affected, but even the defense line of the villa behind may be contaminated by the zombie evil.

Can't let it explode.

Song Qingshan took one step forward.

Zhiyang Zhenqi and Xuanyin soft energy operate at the same time.

Yin energy stalks the corpse.

Yang Jin seals the crystal.

He formed a seal with his hands and forcefully suppressed the corpse crystals that were about to explode in the chests of the two ancient corpses.

The old man in gray robe smiled ferociously: "Can you hold it for one breath or ten?"

"One breath is enough."

Song Qingshan whispered.

The gray-robed old man's heart skipped a beat.

The next moment, Shen Bingxin appeared on the side.

There is no silver needle in her hand.

But a short blade.

The edge of the short blade is coated with light golden liquid.

She is not as fast as Song Qingshan, nor is she as fast as Lu Chen.

But her timing was perfect.

The old man in gray robe focused all his attention on Song Qingshan, and never expected that Shen Bingxin would take the initiative to get close.

The short blade slashed across.

The old man in gray robe's right arm holding the flag was broken at the elbow level.

Kurohata let go.

Song Qingshan immediately raised the black flag with a sword, and the Zhiyang True Fire was instantly ignited.

The corpse flag burned in mid-air.

The resentful soul in the flag rushed out screaming, but was wrapped in Shen Bingxin's requiem incense, and the resentment dissipated little by little.

The old man in gray robe screamed and retreated, black blood spurting out from his severed arm.

For the first time, real fear showed on his face.
